request: My laptop won’t turn on at all, it’s completely dead, had it about 3.5 years now.
notes: KB-03: Laptops eligible for replacement after 3 years or verified hardware failure. Asset Management: Early replacement outside 4-year cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval. Requests need 2 weeks advance notice.

request: Can I get Wi-Fi access for a guest visiting our office tomorrow?
notes: KB-07: Guest Wi-Fi credentials valid for 24h, self-generated at front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket required.

request: I’m locked out of my account, tried my password 6 times.
notes: KB-01: Locked out after 5 failed attempts (tried 6 times). Manual unlock by IT. No approval required.

request: Need approval to install a data-analysis tool that’s not in the software catalog.
notes: KB-04: Non-catalog software requires IT Security review (takes 3-5 business days). Escalate to IT Security.

request: My VPN stopped working this morning, says credentials expired.
notes: KB-02: VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.

request: Printer on the 3rd floor keeps showing “paper jam” even though there’s no jam.
notes: KB-05: First check printer queue and restart print spooler. If issue persists, need printer's asset tag to log ticket.

request: I’ve started working from home 4 days a week, how do I get a monitor?
notes: KB-10: Working remotely >3 days/wk is eligible. Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing; IT handles shipping once approved.

request: I think I got a phishing email asking for my login — forwarding it to a few teammates to check.
notes: KB-09: Suspected phishing must be reported to security@veridian-corp.example immediately and MUST NOT be forwarded to other employees. Urgent security warning!

request: My mailbox is full and I can’t send emails.
notes: KB-06: Default quota 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Increases beyond 25GB require manager approval (capped at 50GB).

request: Can someone give me admin access to the finance reporting server? Need it urgently for month-end.
notes: Security-sensitive server admin access. Requires explicit business justification and authorization (precedent TK-1050 was rejected for lacking justification). Route to System Security & Infrastructure team.

request: New contractor joining my team next week, they’ll need VPN access.
notes: KB-02: Contractors require manager approval submitted via the access request form (not automatic like full-time employees).

request: I can’t log into the expense tool, keeps saying invalid credentials.
initialAction: Waiting on employee response (asked for a screenshot, no reply yet)
notes: KB-08: Access granted by Finance, not IT. IT can assist with login/technical issues only once an account already exists. Help troubleshoot credentials if account exists.

request: Laptop screen is flickering on and off, had it 2 years, might just need a fix not a replacement.
notes: KB-03 & Asset Management: At 2 years, not eligible for standard 3-year replacement unless verified hardware failure. Employee correctly notes it needs hardware diagnostics/repair first.

request: Requesting approval to install a browser extension for productivity tracking.
notes: KB-04: Non-catalog software / browser extensions require IT Security review (3-5 business days). Escalate to IT Security team.
